trust_boundary: All eight profiles integrate read-only fee review and explicit authorization. Exact 42 native 420 from SmartAccount to canonical community Vault, separate controller-paid estimated gas, exact integer gas price/units/cost and independent balance checks. Wallet-retained context only; bounded read-only RPC and generation checks, complete Registry and account discovery; canonical execute envelope simulation and gas estimate pinned to verified block, strict ABI return address validation, creator nonce and canonical blocks rechecked, fresh release/account epoch/policy/template and balances before returning quote. Authorization requires separate user gesture against exact current review and fresh re-simulation. Changed fees, nonce, predicted address or commitments require another review; wrong owner/chain, governance revocation, reorganized blocks, errors, insufficient funds, cancellation, edits and superseded context invalidate consent. In-memory immutable authorization record with reviewed maxGasWei/maxTotalWei, not signing, sending, a capability grant, or actual fee enforcement at broadcast. Downstream submission must independently verify and consume once and enforce cost bounds. Pinned estimate must be supported by RPC; no unpinned fallback. Actual deployment and live provider qualification are not asserted. No production contract or frozen input change.
